# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
platform macos
# desktop-props
tap id:case-desktop-props
expect Title bar
expect Desktop: true desktop desktop
prop id:bar desktop.windowDrag true
prop id:body windowDrag false
covers [props] desktop
covers [props] desktop.windowDrag
# mod-standard-system
tap id:case-mod-standard-system
expect console.identity=true
expect console.results=true
expect os.identity=true
expect os.metadata=true
expect os.home=true
expect process.identity=true
expect process.environment=true
expect process.dataDir=true
expect process.runDenied=true
expect process.spawnDenied=true
expect process.exitDenied=true
expect process.nextTickInvalid=true
expect process.nextTick=true
log standard-system log
log standard-system info
log standard-system debug
log standard-system warn
log standard-system error
covers [console] default
covers [os] default
covers [os] EOL
covers [os] arch
covers [os] homedir
covers [os] platform
covers [process] default
covers [process] arch
covers [process] platform
covers [process] run
covers [process] spawn
covers [process] exit
covers [process] nextTick
covers [globals] process
expect process.childConstructor=true
covers [process] ChildProcess
# mod-standard-files
tap id:case-mod-standard-files
# Files need a desktop; the app declares fs read and write in ${dataDir}.
expect Data dir: true
expect Made: true
expect Read: hello files
expect Bytes: true 11
expect Stat: file true dir false size 11
expect Lstat: dir true link false
expect Listed: a.txt,drafts
expect Entries: a.txt:file,drafts:dir
expect Renamed: false true
expect Removed: 0
expect Missing: ENOENT
# Outside the granted root, and what the app did not declare: refused,
# with the capability the call needs.
expect Outside: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED fs
expect Escape: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED fs
expect Socket: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED network
expect Process: ERR_ACCESS_DENIED process
covers [fs/promises] default
covers [fs/promises] readFile
covers [fs/promises] writeFile
covers [fs/promises] readdir
covers [fs/promises] exists
covers [fs/promises] unlink
covers [fs/promises] rmdir
covers [fs/promises] mkdir
covers [fs/promises] stat
covers [fs/promises] lstat
covers [fs/promises] rename
covers [net] connect
covers [process] run
covers [process] default
# base-dock
tap id:case-base-dock
# Two groups, the first 200 wide; each shows its tabs (in a row, 60
# wide: `tabBarClass`, `tabClass`) and its displayed panel, the others
# placed and hidden.
expect Tab a*
expect Tab b
expect Tab c*
expect Count a: 0
expect Count c: 0
# The other panels are placed (hidden), so they keep their state.
expect Count b: 0
expect Layout h([a* b]:200 [c*])
expect Active a+ c+
frame parent:parent:parent:id:tab-b 60 0 60 24
style parent:parent:parent:id:tab-a backgroundColor #336699ff
prop parent:parent:parent:id:tab-b role tab
# A press selects a tab: the layout comes back with it displayed.
tap text:Tab b
expect Layout h([a b*]:200 [c*])
expect Active a+ c+ a- b+
tap text:Tab a
expect Count a: 0
tap id:inc-a
expect Count a: 1
# A drag of tab a (on a desktop, once it moves) over the middle of c's
# group shows the drop indicator there; the release merges it into that
# group, and the panel's content moves with it: its count is kept.
touch start id:tab-a 10 12
touch move 40 12
touch move 290 150
expect Drop into
expect Preview a
style parent:parent:parent:id:drop backgroundColor #ff0000ff
touch end
absent Drop into
absent Preview a
expect Layout h([b*]:200 [c a*])
expect Count a: 1
expect Removed none
# The ref closes a panel (its group goes), and zooms the group of c.
tap id:close-b
expect Layout h([c a*])
expect Removed b
tap id:zoom-c
expect Zoom a
expect Count a: 1
tap id:unzoom
expect Zoom out
covers [nsh/base] DockArea
covers [props] DockArea.layout
covers [props] DockArea.compact
covers [props] DockArea.tabBarClass
covers [props] DockArea.tabClass
covers [props] DockArea.dropIndicatorClass
covers [props] DockArea.renderTab
covers [props] DockArea.renderPanel
covers [props] DockArea.renderDropIndicator
covers [props] DockArea.renderDragPreview
covers [events] DockArea.onLayoutChange
covers [events] DockArea.onPanelRemove
covers [events] DockArea.onZoomChange
covers [events] DockArea.onPanelActiveChange
# mod-access-denied
tap id:case-mod-access-denied
# The app declares files only: the clipboard, the picker, opening URLs and
# the network are refused. Each call's promise rejects with
# ERR_ACCESS_DENIED, the capability and what was asked for; fetch with a
# TypeError, as every failed fetch.
tap id:run
expect Clipboard: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED clipboard ""
expect Clipboard denied: 7 of 7
expect Picker: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED picker ""
expect Open: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED openUrl "https://example.com/docs"
expect Image size: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED network "https://example.com/a.png"
expect Image prefetch: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED network "https://example.com/b.png"
expect Fetch: TypeError ERR_ACCESS_DENIED network "https://example.com/data"
expect WebSocket: Error ERR_ACCESS_DENIED network "ws://example.com/feed"
expect Global WebSocket: error,1006,false
covers [nsh] Clipboard
covers [nsh] Picker
covers [nsh] openUrl
covers [nsh] Image
